user.title: Connect to GRIT Hub
user.description: Enter the GRIT API settings. After authentication, the integration will attempt bounded, passive MQTT discovery.

confirm.title: Confirm MQTT discovery
confirm.description: Authentication succeeded. The MQTT broker {mqtt_host} and topic hub ID {mqtt_hub_id} were discovered. Continue to use these values, or review the advanced settings.

mqtt_broker.title: Enter the GRIT Hub network address
mqtt_broker.description: The GRIT Hub identity was discovered, but its local network address was not returned by the GRIT API. Enter the GRIT Hub’s LAN hostname or IP address.

data.mqtt_host: GRIT Hub LAN hostname or IP address

advanced.title: MQTT settings
advanced.description: Enter the MQTT broker settings and the Hub's per-hub read-only MQTT username and password. Setup does not use a built-in shared password.

data_description.mqtt_host: Hostname or address of an existing MQTT broker.
data_description.mqtt_hub_id: Hub identifier used in GRIT MQTT topics.
data_description.mqtt_username: Copy the Hub's per-hub read-only MQTT username.
data_description.mqtt_password: Copy the Hub's per-hub read-only MQTT password. A password requires a username.
data_description.mqtt_use_tls: Enable encryption for the MQTT connection.
data_description.mqtt_verify_tls: Verify the broker certificate when TLS is enabled.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GRIT Hub
reconfigure.description: Update connection settings. Leave the API token or MQTT password blank to keep the stored secret. Clearing the MQTT username also clears its password. Enter the Hub's per-hub read-only MQTT credential when replacing a legacy shared default.

data_description.token: Leave blank to retain the stored API token.
data_description.mqtt_password: Leave blank to retain the stored password when a username remains configured.
data_description.mqtt_verify_tls: Applied only when MQTT TLS is enabled.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to GRIT Hub. Check the API URL, token, network path and SSL setting.
error.mqtt_cannot_connect: Could not validate the GRIT MQTT connection and subscription. Check the broker settings.
error.invalid_auth: GRIT rejected the bearer token. Enter a token accepted by the authenticated current-hub API.
error.invalid_base_url: Enter a valid GRIT API base URL.
error.invalid_token: Enter a GRIT API bearer token.
error.invalid_verify_ssl: Select a valid API certificate-verification setting.
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a REST scan interval from 10 to 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_mqtt_host: Enter a valid MQTT broker hostname.
error.invalid_mqtt_port: Enter an MQTT broker port from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_mqtt_hub_id: Enter a valid MQTT topic hub ID.
error.mqtt_credentials_required: Enter the Hub's per-hub MQTT username and password.
error.mqtt_password_requires_username: An MQTT password requires an MQTT username.
error.invalid_mqtt_keepalive: Enter an MQTT keepalive from 1 to 65535 seconds.

abort.already_configured: This GRIT Hub is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The GRIT Hub configuration was updated.

legacy_mqtt_credential.title: Replace the legacy shared MQTT credential
legacy_mqtt_credential.description: This GRIT Hub entry is still using the pre-0.2.0 shared read-only MQTT credential. Reconfigure the integration and enter the Hub's per-hub read-only MQTT username and password.

hub_version_unverified.title: Hub version not verified with this integration
hub_version_unverified.description: This GRIT Hub reports software version {hub_version}. Integration release 0.2.0 was verified against Hub {verified_version}. Setup continues, but behavior on this Hub version is not verified.
